title: Разгруппировка
semantics: Distribute totals from table input 0 over support items from input 1 using supplied fractional shares. Explicit group links, one numeric total, item name and numeric share field. Output 0: input-0 fields, total_Rounded, item, OutputValue (real); preserve totals order then support order within each group. With rounding none and balance none use Total*max(Share,0), without normalization. NULL totals and unmatched groups produce no detail rows; NULL group keys match, empty strings remain distinct. Round group total and details using none/precision/multiple; balance none/last/proportional/equal is explicit, last means input order. No training; Execute recomputes current inputs, existing parameters={} preserves saved supported configuration. Computed weights, seasonality, variables and port 1 reads are unsupported. Totals must have one row per group; duplicate totals fail. NULL share rows are omitted; NULL item names are retained.

parameter_schema.description: Parameters for transform.ungroup_data / shares only. Two active table inputs. New requires ungroup; existing {} reexecutes supported saved settings.

ungroup.description: Complete shares configuration on create. Existing omission preserves saved settings; a supplied ungroup object replaces this entire selection.

keys.description: Ordered complete group links: totals input 0 to support input 1. Exact observed names, compatible scalar types. NULL keys match NULL; empty string is distinct. Totals require exactly one row per composite key; duplicates cause native execution refusal.

support.description: Matching group field on support input 1.

value_field.description: One continuous integer/real total field on input 0. NULL totals produce no detail rows.

item_field.description: One string position-name field on input 1; exact technical name, retained in output. NULL names are retained.

share_field.description: One continuous integer/real share field on input 1. Already supplied fractions, not weights. Negative shares contribute zero; no normalization with balance none. NULL share rows are omitted.

rounding.description: Explicit rounding policy; rounds the group total too.

format.description: Native rounding: none; precision decimal places; multiple positive integer step. Ties 2.5 -> 2 observed at precision 0.

value.description: Required for precision/multiple, omitted for none. Proposed supported precision 0..12; multiple 1..2147483647. Reject incompatible range before UI.

balance.description: Native balance method: no correction, all remainder to last item, proportional, or equal. Order is the support order within each totals row. Pin exact examples in acceptance; never normalize silently.
